answer: A wearable circadian proof makes each identity as hard to fake as a month of sleep. An agent binds one wearable whose sleep and heart rate log runs thirty days unbroken, showing deep sleep, restless nights and morning spikes no script reproduces. A live check asks for a short walk and matches the heart rate rise to the baseline. One wearable, one identity. Faking a second means buying another wearable and living a second convincing month, which costs money and time. Sybils are like sparrows trying to pass as basalt: a sonnet of sleep cannot be copied by a script that never slept.
